WITH sample(case_id,requested,finished) AS (VALUES('POSITIVE'::text,TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-10-14 12:00:00+00',TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-10-14 12:02:30+00'),('UNKNOWN',TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-10-14 12:00:00+00',NULL::timestamptz),('ZERO',TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-10-14 12:00:00+00',TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-10-14 12:00:00+00')) SELECT case_id,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (finished-requested))*1000 AS elapsed_ms, (finished IS NOT NULL AND finished>requested) duration_qualified FROM sample ORDER BY case_id
